title: DDoS Protection and the network perimeter

videos.script: Most attacks want something from you. A denial of service wants nothing, except that your customers cannot reach you. {{nothing}} It arrives as traffic: too much of it, from too many places, to be told apart from real customers by address. {{traffic}} Azure absorbs some of it for every customer, free. A paid plan adds tuning, reports and a team to call. And the application layer is the WAF's job, not this one's. {{layers}} This lesson draws the shop's perimeter, layer by layer, and does the arithmetic of the paid plan. {{end}}
